T_PSBT_PLAIN: A payment your app built but cannot send.
T_FEE_PLAIN: What you pay to get this payment mined. Miners keep it.
T_CHANGE_PLAIN: Coins that come back to your own keys. Whole coins get spent.
T_SEED_PLAIN: Words that rebuild your keys. Any BIP39 compatible signer opens them.
T_PASS_PLAIN: It picks which signer opens. Left empty, it opens the decoy.
T_FP_PLAIN: A short code that names your keys. Your app shows the same one.
T_WATCH_PLAIN: It lets your app see your coins. It cannot spend them.
T_PATH_PLAIN: Which set of keys your words open. Your app must use the same one.
T_RNG_PLAIN: Randomness nobody can guess. From coin flips, dice or a photo.
T_DECOY_PLAIN: A second real signer you can hand over. Keep a little in it.
W_WHATSEED_B: Any BIP39 signer opens them. Write them on paper.
GD_INTRO_S: 一个打开你真正的密钥，一个打开可以给人看的密钥。
GD_INTRO_B: 旁人无法分辨这是备用的还是唯一的。但当着别人写下的字，别人也能照着写。
GD_FUND_B:
备用有自己的指纹和自己的地址。

往里面转一小笔。空着的备用，看起来就像后面还藏着别的东西。
GD_PICK_REAL_S: 任意一次滑动，任意方向。签名器不看是哪一次，所以没有需要记住的。
GD_DRAW_S: 在下面的字上画出你选的那一笔
GD_DRAW_AGAIN_S: 同样的一笔再画一次，免得现在手滑，以后进不去。
GD_DONE_B: 那一笔打不开真正的密钥: 每次都会问你的密码短语。
GD_WORD_S: 写一个短词代替KISS，任何你能照样写两遍的字都可以。
GD_WORD_AGAIN_S: 同样的再写一次，免得现在手滑，以后进不去。
GD_WORD_C_W1_B: 只有你自己的字，和刚才写的一样。KISS在这台设备上不管用。
GD_WORD_C_W2_B: 这里找不回来。你的助记词仍能在兼容的 BIP39 签名器上恢复这些密钥。
GD_WORD_OK_B: 写出你的字，打开备用钱包。再多加一笔，进入你真正的签名器。
L_FP_NOTE_NOPASS: 没有密码短语：仅助记词就能打开这组密钥
L_FP_NOTE2_NOPASS: 之后再加密码短语会打开另一组密钥
L_WARN_T_NOPASS: 这些密钥没有密码短语
L_WARN_B_NOPASS:
只有助记词就能打开。读到的人
都能从里面花钱。

之后再加密码短语会打开另一组
密钥，保护不了这一组。

用指纹认出这一组：
GD_NOPASS_B:
备用钱包只有在真钱包有密码短语时才有意义。这个没有，所以哪条路都打开它。

要用的话，建一个带密码短语的钱包，把币转过去。
W_FLASH_ENC_NOTE: 保存在已加密的内部闪存中。用密码短语解锁。
W_SD_NOTE: 只有本设备能打开的加密文件。解锁前请插卡。
G_STORAGE_CONFIRM_FLASH_B:
将助记词移至内部闪存。

仅在验证闪存副本后删除当前副本。
G_STORAGE_CONFIRM_SD_B:
移至只有本设备能打开的加密 SD 文件。

此卡不是备份。请将助记词记在纸上，以防卡或设备丢失。

仅在验证后删除旧存储。
G_STORAGE_CONFIRM_AMNESIC_B:
删除本设备管理的所有已保存副本。

锁定后，每次使用都必须载入助记词或 SeedQR。
G_STORAGE_OK_FMT:
你的助记词现在存放在 %s。

新副本经过验证后才擦除旧副本。只有开启闪存加密，擦除才等于消失。
G_STORAGE_OK_AMNESIC_B:
已删除保存的助记词。

锁定后，请载入助记词或 SeedQR 重新进入。
G_STORAGE_FAIL_CARD_B:
未找到 SD 卡或无法读取卡上的助记词文件。

什么都没有移动。
G_STORAGE_FAIL_VERIFY_B:
无法验证新副本。

什么都没有移动。
G_STORAGE_FAIL_GENERIC_B:
无法安全完成更改。

什么都没有移动。
G_STOGATE_SENT_SD: Your words move to the card.
G_STOGATE_SURV: your paper words, off this signer
G_STOGATE_GOES: the old stored copy, once the new one verifies
G_STORAGE_OK_NEXT_AMN: Removed. Lock when you are ready.
G_STORAGE_CLEANUP_NEXT: Moved. The old copy would not leave.
G_STORAGE_CLEANUP_T: 存储位置已更改，但有警告
G_STORAGE_CLEANUP_B:
新位置已启用并经过验证，但无法删除旧的已保存副本。

两个位置可能仍有你的词。
I_ROW_HISTORY_SUB: settings, and what this signer has seen
G_HIST_ON_NOTE: settings are saved to flash and survive power off.
G_HIST_ON_NOTE_PLAIN: settings are saved to flash. what this signer has seen needs encrypted flash to outlast the session.
G_HIST_OFF_NOTE: changes last until power off. picking this erases what this signer has seen.
G_SD_ABOUT_B: how full the card is, and the transaction, firmware and backup files on it.
W_KEF_BAD_B: the backup is real but uses a mode this signer does not speak, or it is damaged. backups made here or by a Krux signer with default settings do open.
W_KEF_SD_EMPTY: no .kef backup files on this card.
W_KEF_SD_NONE_B: insert the card that holds the .kef backup, then try again.
W_SD_MISSING_S: 你的词保存在 SD 卡上
W_SD_MISSING_B: 请插入存有你的词的 SD 卡，然后重试。
W_SD_CORRUPT_B:
卡上的词文件已损坏、被更改或属于其他设备。

请使用正确的卡或通过助记词恢复。
W_SD_IO_B:
无法读取 SD 卡。

请重新插入并重试，或通过助记词恢复。
I_WORDS_VERIFIED_FMT: 已核对 · ID %s 在你的纸上
W_MADE_S: what went into the seed this signer holds
W_MADE_NONE: made before this signer kept a record.
W_MADE_ELSE: brought in. it was made on another device.
W_AUD_S: check a part of this signer for yourself
W_RNG_S: does the chip spread its numbers the way real noise does.
W_RNG_SRC_SUB: the chip's noise circuit is off by default. this firmware switches it on at boot and reports it here.
W_RNG_WHY1_B: 5000 numbers, 100 piles, about 50 each. chi square scores the spread. honest noise is in the fair range 499 of 500 runs.
W_RNG_WHY2_B: a formula passes every spread test, so the bars cannot name the source. camera or dice are folded into your keys.
W_RNG_NOSRC_B: with no source these numbers are a formula, and a formula still passes. nothing to audit until the source is back.
W_RNG_RETRY: honest noise misses once in 500 runs. run it again.
S_RM_C_B: 这些将从卡上消失。 未签名的文件都保留。
G_FW_WHERE_B: 卡上放一个 .bin 文件。不看名字，只看签名。
G_FW_WHERE_SHORT: one .bin file in the root of the card
G_FW_NOCARD_B: 把卡插入，再打开这个屏幕。
G_FW_NOFILE_B: 这张卡上没有更新文件。
G_FW_BAD_B: 卡上的文件不是 KISS 文件。
G_FW_BIG_B: 这个文件超出留给它的空间，不是这台设备的版本。
G_FW_UNSIGNED_B: 这个版本没有检查用的密钥。请用 USB 写入已签名的版本。
G_FW_SAME_B: 卡上就是这台设备正在用的版本。
G_FW_WHY_B: 先用设备里的密钥检查，再写入没有在用的那一块闪存。你的词不动。
G_FW_RISK_B: 要用一分时间。中间停下，设备还是用现在的版本。
G_FW_DOWN_B: 这张卡比正在用的旧。回到旧版会丢掉新版改好的地方。
G_FW_DOWN_SHORT: going back gives up whatever the newer one fixed.
G_FW_DARK_B: 写入时不显示任何内容。屏幕从暗中恢复就是进展。
G_FW_OK_B:
重启后就用它。

旧版留在另一块闪存，直到新版启动过一次。
G_TOUCH_DEAD: 触屏不认手指。请重新插电。
G_FW_FAIL_SIG_B:
签名不对。

什么都没有变成可启动，设备还是用原来的版本。
G_FW_FAIL_PQ_B:
the post quantum signature is missing or wrong.

nothing was made bootable and the device still runs the firmware it had.
G_FW_FAIL_CARD_B:
卡在中间停止回应。

什么都没有变成可启动，设备还是用原来的版本。
G_FW_FAIL_WRITE_B:
写入没有完成。

什么都没有变成可启动，设备还是用原来的版本。
I_HIST_SHORT: settings and what it has seen
I_PERSIST_DEAD_PLAIN: amnesic storage keeps nothing, so there is nothing for this to keep. storage changes on the BACKUP tab.
I_ROW_DEVICE_SUB: what is on the card, and this build
I_ERASE_B1: it loses these keys the moment you confirm.
I_ERASE_B2: your words and passphrase are the only way back.
I_CARD_SUB: space, and what is on it
R_UM_OTHER_KEYS: that coordinator is watching different keys
